<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Places a list of orders for each item, together, on paper or live as the workflow trades: live, they reach Polymarket in one request, 15 at a time. Each is checked on its own; an item comes out per order, filled ones out of main, resting ones out of resting, the rest out of missed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `trading.placeOrders` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main`, `resting`, `missed` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Orders (`orders`) | table, its columns below | yes |  | A row per order; or the whole table an expression giving a list of them, like {{ basket }}, each with tokenId, side, price, shares or dollars, and type. |
| Expires after (`expiresAfter`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `1h` | For GTD rows: how long they rest, 3 minutes at the least; then what is left is cancelled. |
| Post-only (`postOnly`) | true or false | no | `false` | For GTC and GTD rows: refused rather than matched at once, so they only ever rest. |

### Orders columns

Each row of **Orders** has these cells. Only the whole table takes an [expression](/docs/guides/expressions/), not its cells.

| Column | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Token (`tokenId`) | text | yes |  | The outcome's token ID. |
| Side (`side`) | text | yes |  | One of `buy`, `sell`. |
| Price (`price`) | number | yes |  | The limit: the most a buy pays per share, the least a sell takes. |
| Shares (`shares`) | number | no |  | How many to buy or sell. |
| Dollars (`dollars`) | number | no |  | A buy of so many dollars instead of shares. |
| Type (`type`) | text | no | `FAK` | One of `FAK`, `FOK`, `GTC`, `GTD`. |
| Market (`marketId`) | text | no |  | Its market's condition ID; looked up when empty. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | object | The order of the list this item is for, and how it went. |
| `order.index` | number | Its place in the list, from 0. |
| `order.tokenId` | text | Its outcome's token ID. |
| `order.side` | text, one of `buy`, `sell` | buy or sell. |
| `order.id` | text | Its ID in the workflow's orders. |
| `order.mode` | text, one of `paper`, `live` | paper: simulated against the live book. live: on Polymarket, from the workflow's wallet. |
| `order.status` | text, one of `filled`, `partial`, `open`, `unfilled`, `refused`, `pending`, `failed` | filled, partial (the rest cancelled), open (resting on the book, filled in part or not yet), unfilled or refused; live, also pending (sent, its outcome not known yet: followed) or failed (matched, but its trades failed on chain). |
| `order.reason` | text; or null | Why it was refused or did not fill wholly. |
| `order.shares` | decimal | Shares it got or sold. |
| `order.dollars` | decimal | Dollars they came to. |
| `order.fees` | decimal | Fees paid, in dollars. |
| `order.price` | decimal; or null | The average price per share; null when nothing filled. |
